sources.title: ViDeBERTa: A powerful pre-trained language model for Vietnamese
sources.snippet: Our empir-ical results demonstrated the state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on Vietnamese downstream tasks: POS tagging, NER, and QA, thus con-firming the effectiveness of our improved pre-trained language model for Vietnamese. Our model, ViDeBERTa, which works with huggingface and transformers, is available to the public.
